post.description: Sign in. Throttled per client: after 5 failures, 429 with `Retry-After` for 15 minutes.

put.description: Change one's own password with the current one; every other session of the account is signed out.
Choose the language the admin is shown in.

get.description: The closest available locale's catalogue (named by `Content-Language`), in Fluent syntax.

put.description: 409 `last_owner` when it would leave no owner.

post.description: The account can no longer sign in and its sessions end at once. 409 `last_owner` for the last owner.

put.description: Set someone else's password (one's own goes through `PUT /me/password`); their sessions end.

post.description: A single-use link, valid 48 hours, carrying the role and the person.
What an invitation offers, before accepting it (no session needed).
Open the account with a login and a password of one's choice; the new account is signed in.

get.description:
Listening beats speaking, then thinking, working (delegated tasks), sleeping (quiet hours), idle.
The journal's stream sends the same as `event: activity` on every change.

put.description: The household's own OAuth client at the provider (its secret is kept encrypted, never shown again).

post.description: Connect a service authorised by typed fields (an app password, a server…).

patch.description: Turn tools off (`disabled_tools`: every tool not listed is on) and choose whether writes ask first.

delete.description: Revoke at the provider when it allows it, then forget every secret of the connection.

get.description: Every pairing method, for a device that has not contacted Nestor yet.
One addition, in progress or over: poll it to follow its `stage`.

delete.description: Cancel an addition in progress: its enrollment code no longer pairs anything.

post.description: Ask a pending device to make itself noticed (it hears it within a second or so).

get.description: One paired satellite; 404 when it is not (or no longer) paired.

delete.description: The device can no longer connect; pairing it again needs a new proof.

post.description: Ask a paired, connected satellite to make itself noticed.
Type the device code a pending device presents; the first proof accepted wins.

and `to` bound the time (`to` excluded); `session`, `task`, `watch`, `connection` and `satellite` keep
one thread.

200.description: Server-Sent Events: `event: item`, `id: <position>`, `data: <JournalItem as JSON>` (the schema `JournalItem`); comment lines as heartbeats. Same filters as the list. Resumes after `Last-Event-ID` (or `after`), else starts with new entries. With `agent.read`, also `event: activity`, `data: <AgentActivityOut as JSON>` (no `id`, the filters do not apply): once at the start, then on every change of what the agent is doing.

get.description: One entry, with its raw record; 404 when it does not exist or is out of reach.
One task, running or among those the manager still keeps; 404 when unknown or out of reach.

post.description: Ask the executor to stop; 404 when the task is unknown, out of reach or already ended.

get.description: One active watch; 404 when unknown, ended or out of reach.
The latest memories, or those matching `q`; `about` keeps one person's (and the household's).

post.description:
Stop everything cleanly (channels close, remote tasks are followed again after), then start
again with the same command line — applying the configuration written since. Never automatic.

get.description:
JSON Schemas of every section and of every installed plugin's settings, with `x-nestor` on each
property (see the module documentation).

put.description:
Validate, then write the file (the previous one goes to the history). 422 `config_invalid` with
`problems` when it cannot be used: nothing is written then. A restart applies it.

post.description: What writing this document would do: its problems (located), else the changes.
Write an earlier file again — validated like any write, and kept in the history itself.

get.description: Every secret set, and every one the configuration refers to (set or not).

put.description: Write-only: the value is never returned, only a preview.

delete.description: 409 `secret_in_use` while the configuration refers to it, unless `force`.

AgentActivityOut.title: AgentActivityOut
AgentActivityOut.description:
What the agent is doing now, from what really runs: `GET /agent/activity`, and `event: activity` on
the journal's stream at its start and on every change.

AgentOut.title: AgentOut
AgentOut.description: The assistant itself, as the front's sidebar shows it.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: What a running component can tell about itself.

JournalItem.title: JournalItem
JournalItem.description:
One journal entry: each sentence as a message (`id` + `args`, for a front with the catalogue) and
as text rendered by the server in the reader's language (so a plugin's events read well even when
the front has no message for them).

LinksOut.title: LinksOut
LinksOut.description: What threads entries together; the front builds threads and chains from these only.

MessageOut.title: MessageOut
MessageOut.description: A message as data: a front with its own Fluent catalogue renders `id` with `args` itself.

MethodOut.title: MethodOut
MethodOut.description: A pairing method, in the reader's language.

PairingMethod.title: PairingMethod
PairingMethod.description: How a person can pair this device; it declares those it supports, the person picks one.

ProblemOut.title: ProblemOut
ProblemOut.description: What is wrong in an edited configuration, located by its path in the document.

ScheduledDeliveryOut.title: ScheduledDeliveryOut
ScheduledDeliveryOut.description: A written follow-up of something said aloud: sent at `due_at` unless someone answers first.

Scope.title: Scope
Scope.description: What an action needs. Code checks scopes, never roles: the role table is the only place they meet.

Stage.title: Stage
Stage.description: Where an addition stands, for the front's progress.
